source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82. **4Q211 ('Astronomical Enochd,' late 1st c. BCE) preserves material GOING BEYOND THE END OF THE GE'EZ ASTRONOMICAL BOOK — confirming the Ge'ez abridgment.**
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 82 — ENOCH'S INSTRUCTIONS TO METHUSELAH on the year's organization + the leaders of the 4 seasons + 12 months + 360 days + 4 epact days. **THE 364-DAY QUMRAN CALENDAR POLEMIC AT ITS SHARPEST** — explicit attack on those who 'do not count' the four extra days (v. 4-6). **4Q211 may preserve Aramaic material EXTENDING BEYOND the end of ch 82 in the Ge'ez** — meaning the original Aramaic Astronomical Book was substantially longer than the Ge'ez tradition. Major scholarly significance (Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000).

verses.text_geez: ወይእዜሰ፡ ወልድየ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘንተ፡ እነግረከ፡ ወእጽሕፈከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለከ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ወወሀብኩከ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ እሉ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəʾəzē-sa waldə-ya Mātusālā kwəlo zanta ʾənaggərə-ka wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka kwəlo la-ka kaśatku wa-wahabku-ka maṣḥafa ba-ʾənta kwəlu ʾəllu
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q211 frag 1 col. i fragmentary parallel (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 pp. 171-175)
verses.notes: **ENOCH ADDRESSES METHUSELAH BY NAME.** Direct father-to-son instruction-frame. 'I am telling you all this and writing it for you. I have given you the book concerning all these.'

verses.text_geez: ዕቀብ፡ ወልድየ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ዘንተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ እምነ፡ እዴሁ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ወታኅሥሥ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ዓለም፡
verses.translit: ʿəqab waldə-ya Mātusālā zanta maṣḥafa ʾəmənna ʾədēhu la-ʾabuka wa-tāḫśəśś la-təwlədomu ʿālam
verses.notes: **TRANSMISSION-COMMAND: 'KEEP this book from your father's hand, and TRANSMIT IT to the generations of the world.'** Enochic-book-tradition as inter-generational covenant-deposit. Cross-corpus: cf. Deut 31:9, 24-26 (Moses deposits the law); cf. 1QS / 1QSa (Qumran community-rule transmission).

verses.text_geez: ጥበበ፡ ወሀብኩከ፡ ለከ፡ ወለውሉድከ፡ ወለእለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ከመ፡ ይሁቡ፡ ለውሉዶሙ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ዘጥበብ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ እምነ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡
verses.translit: ṭəbab-a wahabku-ka la-ka wa-la-wəludə-ka wa-la-ʾəlla yəkawwənu wəludə-ka kama yəhabu la-wəludomu la-təwlədomu zaṭəbab zayətgabbar ʾəmənna ḫolaqomu la-ḍaḥay wa-warḫ wa-kawākəbt
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q211 may preserve fragmentary parallel (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000)
verses.notes: **'I HAVE GIVEN WISDOM (ṭəbab) TO YOU AND TO YOUR CHILDREN' — the calendar = wisdom.** Cross-corpus: wisdom-personification + scribal-tradition. cf. Sir 24 (wisdom dwelling in Israel); cf. 4Q525 + 4Q298 (Qumran wisdom texts). **The Astronomical Book frames calendrical knowledge AS WISDOM** — the calendar is not technical-trivia but the wisdom-revelation.

verses.text_geez: ብፁዓን፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ብፁዓን፡ እለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ በፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ ከመ፡ ኃጥአን፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ዘይትከበቡ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሰማይ፡ ለይከውን፡ በውስቴታ፡ ምስለ፡ አናቅጻተ፡ ዘመንበራቲሁ፡ ዘሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ መራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ለበበ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ዘይትዐጻዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕገጊሆሙ፡ ሰብዓ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
verses.text_aramaic: ברירין כל צדיקיא ברירין אלין די מהלכין באורח קושטא ולית בהון חטאן כאלין חיביא בחושבן יומיא די הוה שמשא מהלך בשמיא בתרעין שתא וקדמיתיהון
verses.translit: běrīrīn kol ṣaddīqayyāʾ běrīrīn ʾillēn dī měhalkīn bě-ʾōraḥ qōšṭāʾ wě-lēt běhōn ḥaṭāʾīn ke-ʾillēn ḥayyābayyāʾ bě-ḥūšbān yōmayyāʾ dī hăwāʾ šimšāʾ měhalek bi-šmayyāʾ bě-tarʿīn šittāʾ wě-qadmāyēhōn
verses.text_geez: ብፁዓን፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ብፁዓን፡ እለ፡ የሐውሩ፡ በፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦሙ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ ከመ፡ ኃጥአን፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡
verses.witness_primary: Aramaic 4Q211 frag 1 col. ii lines 1-9 + 4Q209 frag 28 preserves THE POLEMIC TEXT in Aramaic (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 pp. 172-180; Drawnel 2011 pp. 365-380)
verses.notes: **THE CENTRAL CALENDRICAL-POLEMIC VERSE — preserved in Aramaic.** 'BLESSED are all the righteous, BLESSED are those who walk in the way of righteousness AND HAVE NO SIN LIKE THE SINNERS IN THE COUNTING OF DAYS in which the sun travels in the heaven through the gates...' **THE BEATITUDE-POLEMIC: keeping the right calendar = righteousness; using the wrong calendar = sin.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 6:32-38 ('there will be those who will examine the moon diligently with observation, because it... advances 10 days too soon... and they will surely turn the months of the year and the years and the sabbaths from their order'); cf. MMT B 75-82 (the calendar-priority polemic against the Jerusalem temple establishment); cf. 1QS 1:14-15 ('not to advance their times nor to retreat from any of their seasons'); cf. CD 3:14-15. **The calendar-as-righteousness frame** is the Qumran-community identity-marker. Editor: this is the SHARPEST EDGE of the 364-day-calendar polemic.

verses.text_geez: ወይስሕቱ፡ በበ፡ ዘ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ እልክቱ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ዘይትዌሰክ፡ ለዓመተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ እለ፡ የሐስቡ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ምስለ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወምስለ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡
verses.translit: wa-yəsḥətu baba zaʾ kiyāhomu ʾəlləktu ʾarbāʿtu mawāʿəl zayətwēsak la-ʿāmata ḍaḥay ʾəlla yaḥasbu kiyāhomu məsla mangəśtomu la-ḍaḥay wa-məsla mangəśtomu la-kawākəbt
verses.witness_primary: Aramaic 4Q211 frag 1 col. ii preserves explicit polemic on the four days (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000)
verses.text_aramaic: וטעין בהון אלין ארבעת יומיא די מסתפין לשנת שמשא די לא חשבין בהון עם מלכות שמשא ועם מלכות כוכביא
verses.notes: **'AND THEY ERR concerning THOSE FOUR DAYS that are added to the solar year, THEY who DO NOT COUNT them with the kingdom-of-the-sun and the kingdom-of-the-stars.'** **THE EXPLICIT 364-DAY POLEMIC IN ARAMAIC.** Those who use the 360-day or lunar 354-day year EXPLICITLY ERR. This is the IDENTITY-MARKER of the Qumran-Enochic calendar tradition vs the proto-Rabbinic lunar tradition. **CROSS-CORPUS**: see 82:4 above + Jub 6:32-38 + MMT B. **The Editor will handle this as THE central polemical claim of the Astronomical Book.**

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኢይኄልቍዎሙ፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለዓመት፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኮኑ፡ ለበበ፡ ጥዕና፡ ዘዓመት፡ እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወኢየአምሩ፡ በበ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ዓመት፡ ግን፡ ጻድቅ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወመጽሐፍ፡ ይኄልቅ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጻድቅ፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma sabʾ ʾiyəḫēlqəwwomu baba ḫolaqomu la-ʿāmat yəsḥətu kiyāhomu konu laba-ṭəʿnā za-ʿāmat ʾəsma sabʾ yəsḥətu kiyāhomu wa-ʾiyaʾəmru baba ḫolaqomu laba-ʿāmat gənn ṣādəq yəsamməʿ kiyāhomu wa-maṣḥaf yəḫēlləq kiyāhomu ṣādəq
verses.notes: **'BECAUSE HUMANS DO NOT COUNT THEM in the reckoning of the year, they ERR concerning them.'** Final restatement of the polemic. The righteous one reckons correctly; the book counts truly. **'But the righteous shall heed them, and the book shall count them rightly.'** Editor: the verse-cluster 82:4-6 is the calendrical-identity-marker passage.

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ብርሃናት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕልት፡ ኮኑ፡ ለበበ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ ይትዐጻዑ፡ ለሎቱ፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma bərhānāt ʾəmuntu wa-warḫ wa-ḫolaqomu la-mawāʿəlt konu laba-manbarātihu la-ḍaḥay wa-kawākəbt yətʿaḍḍāʿu lalotu
verses.notes: Closing summary on the luminaries, their stations, and the moon's revolving.

verses.text_geez: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ሕገጊሆሙ፡ ወለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyānihomu zayəkawwən lāʿla mangəśtomu laba-ḥəgagihomu wa-laba-gizēhomu
verses.notes: **Introduces the named LEADERS of the seasons-months-days hierarchy** that follow in vv. 9-20.

verses.text_geez: አርባዕቱ፡ መራኅት፡ እለ፡ ይትፈልጡ፡ አርባዕተ፡ ክፍላተ፡ ዓመት፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ ለአውራኅ፡ ወሰለስቱ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡
verses.translit: ʾarbāʿtu marāḫət ʾəlla yətfaḷaṭu ʾarbāʿta kəfəlāta ʿāmat yəqawwəmu dəḫrēhomu śallastu marāḫət la-ʾawrāḫ wa-salāstu dəḫrēhomu la-mawāʿəl
verses.notes: **HIERARCHY: 4 SEASON-LEADERS / 12 MONTH-LEADERS (3 per season) / further day-leaders.** The angelic-administrative hierarchy governing the calendar.

verses.text_geez: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ሰማን፡ ወያን፡ ቄሊል፡ ወሄሊአምሞ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyānihomu zayəkawwən lāʿla ḫolaqomu la-mawāʿəl Saman wa-Yān Qēlil wa-Hēliʾamamo
verses.notes: **THE FOUR SEASON-LEADER NAMES: SAMAN, YĀN, QĒLIL, HĒLIʾAMAMO** (or variant transliterations). Charles 1912 attempts identifications; these are likely Aramaic month-or-season-leader names corrupted in Ge'ez transmission. Editor: name-identification is a textual crux.

verses.text_geez: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅያን፡ እለ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ መልክኤል፡ ወኤልሜኤል፡ ወሄላምሜሌክ፡ ወሜሌጄል፡ ወናርኤል፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫəyān ʾəlla məslēhomu Malkəʾēl wa-ʾElməʾēl wa-Hēlamamēlek wa-Mēlējēl wa-Nārəʾēl
verses.notes: **ANGEL-NAMES OF SEASON-LEADERS: Melkiel, Helemelek, Meleyal, Narel** (modern critical reconstruction). Charles 1912 reads several variants. **CROSS-CORPUS**: -ʾēl ending angelic names follow the standard Hebrew/Aramaic angelological pattern (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel).

verses.text_geez: ወይከውን፡ መንገሊሆሙ፡ ለመንግሥቶሙ፡ አሐደ፡ ለለ፡ አሐዱ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ድኅረ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ዘመዋዕልት፡ አሐደ፡ ለለ፡ አሐዱ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkawwən mangalihomu la-mangəśtomu ʾaḥada lala ʾaḥadu zayəkawwən dəḫra mangəśtomu la-marāḫət zamawāʿəlt ʾaḥada lala ʾaḥadu
verses.notes: Sub-hierarchy: under each season-leader, day-leaders.

verses.text_geez: ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ ይትፈልጡ፡ ምሳለ፡ መሣክወ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምሳለ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ለበበ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ዘመንበራቲሁ፡ ካዕበ፡ ለለመንበር፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መራኅት፡ እለ፡ ኮኑ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡
verses.translit: śallastu marāḫət yətfaḷaṭu məsāla masākəwa səbʿa məsāla manbarātihu la-ḍaḥay laba-məśrāq zamanbarātihu kāʿba lala-manbar laba-gizēhu śallastu marāḫət ʾəlla konu dəḫrēhomu la-marāḫət laba-gizēhomu
verses.notes: Three sub-leaders per quarter; six windows per gate; the 12-station mechanism in administrative terms.

verses.text_geez: ለቀዳማይ፡ ክፍለ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትለዐሉ፡ መልክኤል፡ ወእሉ፡ መራኅያኒሁ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ክፍለ፡ ዓመት፡ መልክኤል፡ ዘይትበሀል፡ ጸፋዳ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ወፀለለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ መልዕልተ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለሰብዐ፡ ምሥራቅ፡
verses.translit: la-qadāmāyə kəfla ʿāmat yətlaʿalu Malkəʾēl wa-ʾəllu marāḫəyānihu la-qadāmāyə kəfla ʿāmat Malkəʾēl zayətbahal Ṣafādā mangəśtu wa-ḍallala mangəśtu malʿəlta manbaromu la-səbʿa məśrāq
verses.notes: **FIRST QUARTER-LEADER: MALKIEL** ('My king is God'). The angelic season-administrator system parallels the 4Q209/4Q318 Qumran angelological tradition.

verses.text_geez: በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ይከውን፡ ዘይምሉ፡ መልዕልተ፡ ምድር፡ ምክፋላት፡ ሐመስቱ፡ ዐሠርቱ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ብዙኃን፡
verses.translit: ba-mawāʿəlihu yəkawwən zayəməllu malʿəlta mədr məkfālāt ḥamastu ʿaśartu sədəstu məkfālāt bərhānomu la-mawāʿəl bəzuḫān
verses.notes: Daylight-counts for the spring quarter.

verses.text_geez: በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃን፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወመዋዕልት፡ ይነውሑ፡ ወአራዊት፡ ወጥይም፡ ይትከበቡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይከውን፡ መዋዕል፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ይነውሕ፡
verses.translit: ba-mawāʿəlihu yəkawwən bərhān lāʿla mədr wa-mawāʿəlt yənawwəḥu wa-ʾarāwit wa-ṭəyəm yətkababu lāʿla mədr wa-yəkawwən mawāʿəl la-mawāʿəl yənawwəḥ
verses.notes: **Spring associations: animals come forth, days lengthen, plants flourish.** Phenological-calendar associations.

verses.text_geez: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ እለ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ቤርቤኤል፡ ወዘላቤኤል፡ ወሣልስ፡ ዘያትዌሰክ፡ ዘይሰምዮ፡ ሄሌአሞ፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ ምራኅቲሆሙ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫət ʾəlla dəḫrēhu Bērbēʾēl wa-Zalābēʾēl wa-śāləs zayātwēsak zayəsamməyo Hēlēʾamamo wa-mawāʿəla mərāḫətihomu yətfēṣamu
verses.notes: **Three sub-leaders of the SPRING QUARTER: Berbeel, Zalabeel, Heleyaseph (variants).** The 3-sub-leaders-per-quarter system = 12 month-leaders total (3 × 4).

verses.text_geez: ካልዕ፡ መርሕ፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ሄለሜሌክ፡ ስሙ፡ ዘጻድቅ፡ ብርሃን፡ ይጼውዕዎ፡
verses.translit: kāləʿ marḥ dəḫrēhu Hēlamamēlek səmu zaṣādəq bərhān yəṣēwwəʿwwo
verses.notes: **SECOND QUARTER-LEADER: HELEMELEK** ('the resplendent / shining sun' — Aramaic ḥel = sun-strength). Summer-quarter angel.

verses.text_geez: ወመዋዕሊሁ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ መዋዕልት፡ ይነውሑ፡ ወሌሊት፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ወሕግጋቲሁ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ድርቅ፡ ወሞቅ፡ ወአራዊት፡ ይምልኡ፡ ወብርሃን፡ ይነውኅ፡ ወሌሊት፡ ይሕጽጽ፡
verses.translit: wa-mawāʿəlihu la-mangəśtu mawāʿəlt yənawwəḥu wa-lēlit yaḥaḍḍəḍ wa-ḥəgagāttihu la-mangəśtu yəkawwən dərq wa-moq wa-ʾarāwit yəməllu wa-bərhān yənawwəḫ wa-lēlit yəḥaḍḍəḍ
verses.notes: **Summer associations: long days, short nights, drought, heat, abundant animals.** Phenological.

verses.text_geez: ወእሉ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመራኅት፡ ድኅሬሁ፡ ጊዳኤል፡ ወቄኤል፡ ወሄኤል፡ ወስሙ፡ ለመርሐ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ፡ ዘይትዌሰክ፡ አስፋኤል፡ ወመዋዕለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəllu səmātihomu la-marāḫət dəḫrēhu Gidāʾēl wa-Qēʾēl wa-Hēʾēl wa-səmu la-marḥa dəḫrēhomu zayətwēsak ʾAsfaʾēl wa-mawāʿəla mangəśtu yətfēṣamu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1912 82:20; Knibb 1978 vol. 2 p. 177) — text ends here in the Ge'ez; **4Q211 frag 1 col. ii preserves CONTINUATION-MATERIAL beyond this point (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 pp. 174-179; Drawnel 2011 pp. 379-385) — meaning the original Aramaic Astronomical Book continued beyond the Ge'ez ending.**
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q211 frag 1 col. ii has extra-Ge'ez material
verses.notes: **FINAL VERSE IN THE GE'EZ — but NOT the final verse of the original Aramaic Astronomical Book.** Closing names of summer-quarter sub-leaders: Gidael, Keel, Heel, plus the additional Asfael. **MAJOR SCHOLARLY POINT: 4Q211 preserves Aramaic continuation beyond the Ge'ez ending of the Astronomical Book**, indicating the Ge'ez tradition is an ABRIDGMENT of a longer Aramaic original. The autumn + winter quarter-leader hierarchies (which the symmetry demands and 4Q211 partly preserves) were lost in the Ge'ez transmission. Editor: the Ge'ez ends mid-pattern — at summer-quarter (Hēlamamēlek). The expected autumn (Mēlējēl?) and winter (Nārəʾēl?) quarter sections per 82:11 were lost or summarized away in the Ethiopic. **The 4Q211 extra-Ge'ez material is one of the most significant Astronomical-Book scholarly findings** — confirming Milik 1976's reconstruction-hypothesis that the original Aramaic Astronomical Book was substantially fuller than what survives in the Ge'ez. **End of Ship B source-acquisition for 1 Enoch 72-82.**
